services.name: Sand & refinish hardwood
services.blurb: Three sanding passes down to bare wood, then three coats of finish, with dust contained.

services.name: Screen & recoat
services.blurb: Dull but unscratched floors buffed and given a fresh coat in one day, no sanding.

services.name: Stain samples on your floor
services.blurb: Four or five stain swatches brushed onto your own boards so you choose in your light.

services.name: Board repair & lacing
services.blurb: Cracked, burned or pet-stained boards cut out and new ones woven in to match the grain.

services.name: New hardwood floors
services.blurb: Solid oak or maple nailed down, acclimated in your house first, sanded and finished on site.

services.name: Stair treads & risers
services.blurb: Worn or carpeted stairs sanded or re-treaded and finished to match the floor at the top.

services.name: Squeaks & soft spots
services.blurb: Squeaky or bouncy spots screwed down from below or above before any refinishing starts.

services.name: Tile floors
services.blurb: Kitchen, bath and laundry tile set flat on a proper base, with straight grout lines.

services.name: Luxury vinyl plank
services.blurb: Click-together vinyl plank for basements and rentals, over a flat, checked subfloor.

services.name: Thresholds & transitions
services.blurb: Wood-to-tile and room-to-room transitions cut flush so nobody catches a toe.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our 1920s bungalow had three layers of old finish and some black water rings by the radiator. Wes showed us each sanding pass. The rings came out on the second one. The red oak underneath was a surprise.
reviews.name: Laurel B.

reviews.text: We could not picture the stain from a tiny chip. They brushed five swatches on the actual floor by the window and left them for a day. We picked the one we least expected.
reviews.name: Marcus E.

reviews.text: The dog wore through the finish by the back door and stained four boards. They wove in new boards and I honestly cannot find them now.
reviews.name: Jenna C.

reviews.text: Floors were dull, not scratched, so they told me a recoat would do and saved me the full sanding. Done in a day, and we walked on it in socks that night.
reviews.name: Robert G.

reviews.text: Carpeted stairs turned out to be oak underneath. They pulled the tack strips, filled the staple holes and matched the color to the hall. The kids still slide down them in socks.
reviews.name: Annie W.

reviews.text: Dust was my biggest worry with a baby in the house. They sealed off the hall with plastic and ran the vacuum on the sander. Wiped one shelf the next day and that was it.
reviews.name: Kayla F.

proof.guarantee: If the finish peels or clouds in the first 2 years, we come back and redo that room.
